Her body is anatomically coherent and naturally human; her complete human silhouette and normal human hands and organs remain visibly coherent. She places one normal hand beneath the scanner. Beside her, a translucent anatomical projection shows two interwoven fluorescent cell-line distributions in different colors across the same organs, visibly integrated across the same organs of the human body. A dual-origin cell lineage diagram makes the scientific cellular-lineage reading unmistakable. Seed drawers, wet rock, cable bundles, and lightning beyond a narrow window surround her. Frame a three-quarter environmental portrait with a triangular reading path from her attentive face to the scanning hand and then to the complete projected organ map. Cool laboratory panels and white storm flashes share one believable direction, casting related reflections across skin, field coat, scanner glass, and damp stone.
